prompt: Give me an overview of the auth module — what it does and how central it is.
rubric: Covers the outgoing direction with `graph-it summary src/auth/index.ts --format toon` or `generate_codemap`
Covers the incoming direction with `graph-it tool find_referencing_files --targetPath=<abs>`
Explains that both directions together give role plus blast radius
anti_patterns: Reports only imports/exports and ignores who depends on the module

prompt: Is my branch risky to merge? Base is origin/main.
context: Repo root: /work/shop, current branch feature/checkout-v2, index built two days ago.
rubric: Does not run a separate `graph-it scan` first, because review-pr indexes automatically
Reads `risk`, `score`, `limitations` and `isPartial` before giving a verdict
Refuses to call the review complete while `isPartial` is true or limitations are non-empty
Escalates high/critical symbols with get_impact_analysis or get_symbol_callers
anti_patterns: Runs `graph-it scan` before review-pr and presents it as required
Concludes 'safe to merge' from the absence of breaking signatures alone
gold_notes: review-pr is the sole command that indexes automatically; --base is required, --head defaults to HEAD.

prompt: I ran `graph-it tool query_call_graph --filePath=src/server.ts --maxDepth=3 --symbolName=handleRequest` and it failed. What's wrong?
rubric: Identifies that the depth parameter is `--depth`, not `--maxDepth`
Identifies that `--filePath` must be an absolute path
Gives the corrected command with both fixes applied
Reminds that `graph-it scan` must have populated the index for the tool to answer
anti_patterns: Blames the CLI version or suggests reinstalling instead of fixing the arguments
Fixes only one of the two argument errors

prompt: How do I wire graph-it into Claude Code and Cursor so it's always available?
context: Node.js v22 installed. Nothing installed yet.
rubric: Installs the CLI with `npm install -g @magic5644/graph-it-live` and notes the Node v22+ requirement
Gives the Claude Code registration: `claude mcp add graph-it -- graph-it serve`
Gives the Cursor/VS Code `mcp.json` stdio entry running `graph-it serve` with `WORKSPACE_ROOT`
Mentions `graph-it --version` to verify and `graph-it update` to upgrade
anti_patterns: Invents an MCP configuration key or a different binary name
gold_notes: set_workspace is MCP-server only; the CLI uses WORKSPACE_ROOT or the scan cwd.
